;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Poisoning of Yulia and Sergei Skripal]]
**[[Leader of the Opposition (United Kingdom)|UK Leader of the Opposition]] [[Jeremy Corbyn]] of [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour]] asks to see "incontrovertible evidence" before accepting [[Russia]] was responsible. [[Secretary of State for Foreign and Commonwealth Affairs|Foreign Secretary]] [[Boris Johnson]] responds, saying it is "quite extraordinary" to question Russian involvement. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-43774132 (BBC News)]
*[[Afghanistan–Pakistan skirmishes]]
**[[Afghanistan|Afghan]] and [[Pakistan]]i forces exchange cross-border fire on the [[Durand Line]], killing two [[Pakistan Army]] troops and injuring five others. [https://www.voanews.com/a/violene-at-pakistan-afghan-border/4348823.html (''Voice of America'')]
*[[Sinai insurgency]]
**[[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] claims responsibility for an attack on a military base in the [[Sinai Peninsula]], [[Egypt]], yesterday that killed eight soldiers and injured fifteen. The [[Egyptian Military]] said 14 militants were killed in the attack. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/islamic-state-claims-attack-in-egypts-sinai-that-killed-8/2018/04/15/42989678-40a5-11e8-b2dc-b0a403e4720a_story.html?noredirect=on&utm_term=.5be4970f1790 (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[2018 Gaza border protests]]
**[[Gaza Strip|Gazans]] launch a kite carrying a firebomb over the [[Israel]]i border near [[Kibbutz Kissufim]], starting a fire in a field. It is the fourth such incident this week. Local authorities alert residents to be vigilant for potential repeat attacks. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/gazans-fly-kite-with-petrol-bomb-into-israel-sets-field-afire/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[Iraqi insurgency (2017–present)]]
**A car bomb in [[Kirkuk]], [[Iraq]], kills and injures several civilians. The blast follows a bombing at Hor Rajab, [[Baghdad]], earlier in the day that wounded one civilian. [https://www.iraqinews.com/iraq-war/ten-iraqi-people-killed-injured-in-car-bomb-blast-in-kirkuk/ (Iraqi News)]
*[[Israel Defense Forces]] announce the destruction of a [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]-[[Israel]] tunnel thought to belong to [[Hamas]], with Defence Minister [[Avigdor Liberman]] claiming it to be the longest tunnel found to date. [http://www.jerusalemonline.com/news/politics-and-military/military/idf-destroys-longest-terror-tunnel-recorded-to-date-35459 (Jerusalem Online)]
*Militants disguised as [[United Nations]] troops attack two military bases near [[Timbuktu]], [[Mali]], using rockets and two car bombs. At least one soldier at the bases, used by [[France]] and the UN, is killed and more than twelve others are wounded. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-43772363 (BBC News)]
*[[Russia]] sends  [[landing ship]] ''Nikolai Filchenkov'', chartered civilian vessel MV ''Alexander Tkachenko'', and transport ship ''Orsk'' to [[Syria]] laden with military equipment. [http://metro.co.uk/2018/04/16/russia-sends-reinforcement-warships-loaded-tanks-syria-7470337/ (''Metro'')]

;Arts and culture
*[[Destruction of cultural heritage by ISIL]]
**Deputy tourism and antiquities minister Qais Hussein Rashid unveils a [[United Nations]]-brokered plan for "re-constructing touristic, archaeological and heritage sites" damaged by [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] in [[Mosul]]. [https://www.iraqinews.com/features/iraq-declares-un-initiative-to-rehabilitate-ancient-sites-in-nineveh/ (Iraqi News)]
*Prominent [[New York City|New York]] [[LGBT rights|LGBT]] and environmental lawyer [[David Buckel]] commits [[suicide]] by [[Self-immolation|setting himself on fire]] with petrol in [[Prospect Park (Brooklyn)|Prospect Park]]. He leaves and circulates a [[suicide note]] indicating his death is in protest against the use of [[fossil fuels]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-43773650 (BBC News)]
*[[Theology of Pope Francis]]
**[[Pope Francis]] comforts a crying boy in [[Casone|San Paolo della Croce]], [[Rome]], by telling him his recently-deceased father, an [[atheism|atheist]], will have ascended to heaven on the basis his father had "a good heart". [http://www.ansa.it/english/news/vatican/2018/04/16/your-atheist-days-in-heaven-pope-to-boy_4db0a12c-9a46-4d49-985d-8cd3f0a42507.html (A.N.S.A.)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[List of shipwrecks in 2018|Shipwrecks in 2018]]
**[[Fire and Emergency New Zealand]] announce they hope the fire aboard [[Korean Peninsula|Korean]] ship FV ''Dong Won 701'' is extinguished seven days after catching light in the [[timaru|Port of Timaru]], [[New Zealand]]. Firefighters say they plan to board the vessel tomorrow to confirm. [https://www.stuff.co.nz/timaru-herald/news/103116032/fire-crews-to-reenter-korean-fishing-boat-to-check-on-fires (Stuff)]
*[[2017–18 Australian bushfire season]]
**A [[state of emergency]] is declared in [[New South Wales]], [[Australia]], as a [[bushfire]] continues to burn out of control. More than 500 personnel from the [[New South Wales Rural Fire Service]], [[Fire and Rescue NSW]] and the [[Australian Defence Force]] are tackling the bushfire, which has torn through the [[Holsworthy Barracks]] and threatens the suburbs of [[Sydney]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2018/apr/16/anxious-sydney-residents-hope-for-best-as-bushfire-threat-eases (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2017 M1 motorway crash]]
**The [[United Kingdom|UK]] [[Department of Transport]] rejects a call by road safety campaign [[non governmental organisation|NGO]] [[Brake (charity)|Brake]] for tougher legislation on licencing for commercial drivers in response to a crash that killed eight last year. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-beds-bucks-herts-43739273 (BBC News)]

;Health and environment
*[[Rose Acre Farms]] recalls around 207 million eggs from a farm in [[North Carolina]] after 22 people fell ill with suspected ''[[salmonella|Salmonella braenderup]]''. It is the largest recall of eggs in the [[United States]] since [[2010]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-eggs-recall/u-s-recalls-more-than-200-million-eggs-over-salmonella-fears-idUSKBN1HM0NX (Reuters)]
*Former [[U.S. First Lady]] [[Barbara Bush]] declines further medical treatment for serious ongoing health issues. [http://kfor.com/2018/04/15/barbara-bush-in-failing-health-wont-seek-further-treatment/ (KFOR-TV)]

;International relations
*[[Syria–United States relations]], [[2018 bombing of Damascus and Homs]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] warns [[Syria]]'s [[Government of Syria|government]] that the [[United States|U.S.]] is "locked and loaded" to strike again if Syria were to carry out new chemical attacks. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-43771840 (BBC News)]
*[[Bangladesh–Tajikistan relations]]
**[[Tajikistan]] foreign minister [[Sirodjidin Aslov]] meets with [[Bangladesh]] [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Bangladesh)|State Minister of Foreign Affairs]] [[Shahriar Alam (politician)|Shahriar Alam]]. [https://bdnews24.com/bangladesh/2018/04/15/bangladesh-tajikistan-hold-talks-to-take-ties-to-a-new-height (Bdnews24.com)]
*[[2018 Arab League summit]]
**The [[Arab League]] summits in [[Dhahran]], [[Saudi Arabia]], their first meeting since the [[Qatar diplomatic crisis]], focused on [[Jerusalem]] and [[Iran]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/04/arab-leaders-mute-syria-strikes-saudi-summit-180415174014924.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Law and crime
*[[Israel]]i authorities release 207 [[Africa]]n migrants from [[Saharonim Prison]] after a [[Supreme Court of Israel|Supreme Court]] ruling ordering their release amid deportation negotiations. The migrants had refused to leave the country voluntarily. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/israel-frees-207-african-migrants-from-detention-as-deportation-talks-persist/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*An [[improvised explosive device]] damages a shopfront in [[Limassol]], [[Cyprus]]. [http://cyprus-mail.com/2018/04/15/explosion-damages-limassol-shop-2/ (''The Cyprus Mail'')]
*A court in [[Somaliland]] jails poet Nacima Qorane for three years for bringing the state into contempt by writing a poem calling for reunification with [[Somalia]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-43775951 (BBC)]
*Hundreds of [[Haredi Judaism|ultra-Orthodox Jews]] riot outside the [[Israel Defense Forces]] draft office in [[Jerusalem]] after rumours emerge of a female draft dodger being arrested in [[Har Nof]]. Police open fire with [[water cannon]]s and [[stun grenade]]s. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/4-cops-injured-as-hundreds-of-ultra-orthodox-jews-riot-in-jerusalem/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*Inmates at E Wing of [[HMYOI Aylesbury]] in [[Buckinghamshire]], [[England]], riot, injuring four [[prison officer]]s. A woman claiming to be an inmate's partner says the riot was in response to the inmates being housed ''en masse'' in [[solitary confinement]] without association with other prisoners for at least a week. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-beds-bucks-herts-43775829 (BBC News)]
*[[Turkmenistan]] bans the import of bikinis, shorts, and swimsuits. [https://www.rferl.org/a/too-hot-for-the-beaches-turkmenistan-bans-imports-of-bikinis/29168513.html (RadioFreeEurope / Radio Liberty)]
*[[Boston Marathon bombing]]
** [[Boston]] marks the fifth anniversary of the April 2013 bombing with a private ceremony inside the [[Boston Public Library]]. The bells at a local church rang at 2:49 p.m. to mark the exact time the two bombs exploded seconds apart near the marathon's finish line. [https://apnews.com/article/north-america-ap-top-news-marty-walsh-sports-boston-3b6b681b9561423ea356ff2579342ea4 (AP News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Guatemala]]
**[[Guatemalan territorial dispute referendum, 2018]]
***Millions of [[Guatemalans]] are summoned to participate in a referendum in which they will determine if they submit to the [[International Court of Justice]] the [[Belizean–Guatemalan territorial dispute|territorial, insular and maritime dispute]] with [[Belize]]. [https://www.telesurtv.net/english/news/Referendum-to-Decide-if-Guatemala-Belize-Dispute-Goes-to-ICJ--20180413-0007.html (''tele<small>SUR</small>'')]
**The election of the candidates for [[Attorney General of Guatemala]] and successor of [[Thelma Aldana]] has concluded and 14 candidates have obtained the necessary qualifications to participate. [[President of Guatemala|President]] [[Jimmy Morales]] will appoint the Attorney General in the coming days. [https://www.telesurtv.net/english/news/Jimmy-Morales-to-Pick-General-Attorney-20180414-0007.html#cxrecs_s (''tele<small>SUR</small>'')]
*[[Montenegrin presidential election, 2018]]
**The Presidential election begins in [[Montenegro]], with [[Milo Đukanović]] of the [[Dominant-party system|hegemonic]] [[Democratic Party of Socialists of Montenegro]] and [[independent candidate]] [[Mladen Bojanić]] being the favorites in the polls. [https://www.foreignbrief.com/daily-news/20563/ (Foreign Brief)]
*[[2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis]], [[Catalan independentism]]
**315,000 demonstrators in [[Barcelona]] demand the freedom of jailed separatist leaders and [[freedom of speech]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/apr/15/catalan-protesters-call-for-return-of-jailed-or-exiled-leaders (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Efforts to impeach Donald Trump]]
** Former FBI Director [[James Comey]] doesn’t believe [[Donald Trump]] should be impeached, despite saying that he’s “morally unfit” to be president. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/04/15/politics/trump-comey-abc-impeachment/index.html (CNN)]

;Science and technology
*[[List of asteroid close approaches to Earth in 2018|Asteroid close approaches to Earth in 2018]]
**An asteroid, [[2018 GE3]], sized between {{convert|37|and|138|m|ft}} passes {{convert|193,000|km|mi}} from [[Earth]], possibly the largest known asteroid to ever pass that close in observational history. [https://minorplanetcenter.net/mpec/K18/K18G94.html (Minor Planet Center)]
**Another asteroid, {{mp|2018 GY|3}}, which had passed {{convert|301,000|km|mi}} from Earth on April 10, is identified as the lost asteroid {{mp|2008 GY|21}}, which had passed similarly close to Earth in 2008. [https://www.minorplanetcenter.net/mpec/K18/K18GC3.html (Minor Planet Center)]
*Scientists say that they have identified genes that cause deadly heart condition [[pulmonary arterial hypertension]] which kills 50% of those affected within five years. [https://www.bbc.com/news/health-43727026 (BBC News)]
*[[USS Portland (LPD-27)|USS ''Portland'']], a new [[United States]] naval ship costing  [[US$|$]]1.6 billion, arrives and docks in [[Portland, Oregon]], ahead of being formally commissioned later this month. [http://www.kgw.com/article/news/local/new-navy-ship-uss-portland-arrives-in-portland/283-537996331 (KGW)]

;Sports
*[[Athletics at the 2018 Commonwealth Games – Men's marathon]]
**[[Scotland|Scottish]] athlete [[Callum Hawkins]] collapses twice and strikes his head. Journalists, fellow athletes, and [[Commonwealth Games Scotland]] criticise a delay in him receiving medical assistance. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/athletics/2018/04/15/scotlands-callum-hawkins-collapses-leading-marathon-final-day/ (''The Telegraph'')] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/commonwealth-games/43775030 (BBC Sport)] [http://www.heraldscotland.com/news/homenews/16160426.Callum_Hawkins_speaks_from_hospital_bed_after_collapse_while_leading_marathon/ (''Herald Scotland'')]
*[[2017–18 Premier League]]
**[[association football|Football]] team [[Manchester United F.C.|Manchester United]] lose 1-0 to [[West Bromwich Albion F.C.|West Brom]], handing [[Manchester derby|rivals]] [[Manchester City F.C.|Manchester City]] the [[Premier League]] title. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/43774961 (BBC Sport)]
*[[2018 NBA Playoffs]]
**The [[Indiana Pacers]] defeat the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]] 98–80 in Game 1 of their [[Eastern Conference (NBA)|Eastern Conference]] first-round series [[Quicken Loans Arena|in Cleveland]], snapping [[LeBron James]]' personal streak of 21 consecutive wins in the first round. [https://www.thestar.com/sports/basketball/2018/04/15/pacers-upset-cavs-to-snap-lebron-james-first-round-win-streak.html (''The Star'')]
